decisions.why: HoLEP sets, single use ureteroscopes and cystoscopes, ClearPetra access sheaths, the Genius morcellator, the Ellick bladder evacuator, S dilators and a line named 'Endourology Consumables' are endourology; the same division separately names Polymer Ligation Clips, which are clips and clip appliers
the division names Single Use Hysteroscopes and a Bipolar Plasma System — gynaecological endoscopy. Urolon, the third line, is an injectable and is not claimed under this or any other category
the division holds an ERCP scope, a Single Use Choledochoscopes range and Bile Duct Exploration Accessories — endoscopy devices and consumables only
